integer_seconds_policy: Conservative local compiler policy; confirm provider support before submitting fractional or other durations.
notes: 30-second maximum and 30 image / 10 video / 10 audio reference capacities are model-level documentation; provider/mode limits may be smaller.
4-second minimum is a conservative local delivery policy, not a claim about every Seedance 2.5 endpoint.
Internal mode names and reference aliases must be bound to the actual product interface.
Human review boards remain <=15 seconds. A >15-second generation job needs an explicitly approved multi-shot production grouping.
